lines.rom: namo namo durge sukha karani namo namo ambe duhkha harani

sasi lalata mukha maha visala netra lala bhrkuti vikarala
rupa matu ko adhika suhave darasa karata jana ati sukha pave
tuma samsara sakti laya kina palana hetu anna dhana dina
annapurana hui jaga pala tuma hi adi sundari bala
pralayakala saba nasana hari tuma gauri siva samkara pyari
siva yogi tumhare guna gavaim brahma visnu tumhem nita dhyavaim
rupa sarasvati ko tuma dhara de subuddhi rsi munina ubara
dhara rupa narasimha ko amba paragata bhai phara kara khamba
raksa kari prahalada bacayo hiranakusa ko svarga pathayo
